title: Backup & reset
description: Download a complete backup package or reset the organization to a clean state.

create.title: Create a backup
create.description: A ZIP package with a manifest and one JSON and one Excel file per table. Uploaded files are not included — only their metadata.
create.sensitiveNote: Salary and bank accounts are included only in backups made by the Super Admin.
create.format: ZIP · manifest.json · JSON + XLSX per table

history.title: Backup history
history.empty: No backups have been downloaded yet.
history.noAccess: The backup history is read from the audit trail, which requires the audit permission.

reset.title: Reset organization
reset.description: Permanently deletes the organization's data and returns the portal to its first-time setup. This cannot be undone.

deleted.people: All employees and their records: Iqama, passport, dependents, insurance, documents, compensation and bank accounts
deleted.operations: All requests, approvals, comments, leave balances and leave requests, certificates and notifications
deleted.structure: Departments, job titles, locations, cost centers, public holidays and import history
deleted.configuration: Request types, workflows, leave types and templates — restored to the default configuration
deleted.accounts: Every user account except the Super Admins
deleted.files: All uploaded files: documents, attachments, certificate PDFs and branding images

kept.admins: Super Admin accounts and their sign-in
kept.audit: The complete audit trail (the reset itself is recorded)
kept.code: The application and its database structure

reset.backupFirst: Download a backup first — it is the only way to recover the data.
reset.onlySuperAdmin: Only the Super Admin can reset the organization.
reset.dialogDescription: Everything listed under “Deleted” is removed permanently. You will be signed out and continue with the setup wizard.
reset.passwordHint: Confirm it's you before this action.

errors.downloadFailed: The backup could not be created. Please try again.

toast.resetDone: The organization was reset. Sign in to start the setup.
toast.resetDoneFilesPending: The organization was reset, but some stored files could not be removed. Sign in to start the setup.
